baseline.scope_zh: 双状态参考例子，解析LQR独立对照。
baseline.outcome_en: The saved baseline reaches the analytic LQR gain in five policy-evaluation rounds; the final gain error is 8.37e-14.

koopman_l4dc2025.model_zh: 连续非线性，辨识生成元
koopman_l4dc2025.scope_en: Normalized pendulum variant; not every paper table.
koopman_l4dc2025.scope_zh: 归一化摆数值变体，未完整复刻原表。
koopman_l4dc2025.outcome_en: Fifty recorded closed-loop trajectories have a maximum terminal state norm of 1.23e-3. Average cumulative cost across the 50 initial states is compared with true-model PI: the maximum absolute difference over 0–10 s is 3.15e-5.

meanfield_lqg2025.scope_en: Finite-sample social optimization; low-sample failures retained.
meanfield_lqg2025.scope_zh: 有限样本社会优化，保留小样本失败。
meanfield_lqg2025.outcome_en: The documented 4,000-path run reports gain errors of approximately 0.53% and 0.85%. Low-sample failures and independent training repeats are retained.

run_examples.label: Default: 100 training paths
run_examples.note: The default example uses 100 training paths. The saved 0.53% / 0.85% gain errors come from a separate 4,000-path record.

run_examples.label: Precision procedure: 40 × 100 paths
run_examples.note: This existing procedure pools batches under a common probe and fits at 100, 400, 1,000 and 4,000 paths. A small-sample fit may stop it before 4,000. Exact replay of the historical numbers still needs the archived configuration and data; see the run guide.

qlearning_tac2023.scope_en: Data-based LQR; explicit MIMO initialization variant.
qlearning_tac2023.scope_zh: 数据驱动LQR，MIMO初始化为明确变体。
qlearning_tac2023.outcome_en: The implementation documents a data-based stabilizing initialization, a discrete LQR comparison, and an explicit MIMO initialization variant. The linked record contains local checks.

pinn_infinite_horizon2025.scope_en: Reduced LQR/pendulum training; corrected quartic cost identified.
pinn_infinite_horizon2025.scope_zh: 缩小网络的LQR/摆训练，标明四次代价修正。
pinn_infinite_horizon2025.outcome_en: The saved reduced pendulum experiment completes four closed-loop evaluations at each continuation horizon, from 1 through 4. The figure shows the trained value on the common grid at horizon 4.

run_examples.label: Short workflow: smoke
run_examples.note: Smoke trains scalar LQR at horizon 1 and pendulum at horizons 1–2 for 10 updates each, plus two 12-update prefix checks.

run_examples.label: Figure configuration: reduced
run_examples.note: The horizon-4 figure uses reduced training: 2,000 LQR updates and 3,000 per pendulum horizon, 1–4. This is the smaller network experiment, not the full paper schedule.

safe_pinn_icml2025.scope_en: Boat example; collision and budget violations remain.
safe_pinn_icml2025.scope_zh: 船舶场景，仍存在碰撞和预算违例。
safe_pinn_icml2025.outcome_en: Of the same 64 candidates, reduced training executes 64: 19 collisions, 47 budget violations. The author checkpoint executes 63: 1 collision, 9 budget violations. Events may overlap.

run_examples.label: Reduced training: 5,000 updates
run_examples.note: This trains and evaluates a new MATLAB network. The run guide below separately explains author-checkpoint inference using external converted weights and an existing result.mat with the comparison inputs.

robust_koopman2026.scope_en: Held-out error bound fails on 25.55% of points.
robust_koopman2026.scope_zh: 留出点中25.55%违反拟合误差界。
robust_koopman2026.outcome_en: The fitted error bound fails on 25.55% of held-out points in the preserved evaluation.

bias_pi_automatica2026.model_zh: 未知连续非线性系统，固定数据
bias_pi_automatica2026.scope_en: Pendulum/arm variants; arm cost is 8.84% above local LQR.
bias_pi_automatica2026.scope_zh: 摆/机械臂变体，臂成本比局部LQR高8.84%。
bias_pi_automatica2026.outcome_en: The recorded arm variant stabilizes, with cost 8.84% above the local LQR comparison.

run_examples.label: Recorded arm variant
run_examples.note: The displayed 8.84% cost gap belongs to this local-multistart arm variant over five seconds. Its LQR comparison requires Control System Toolbox.
